title: Flux requests get more reliable defaults
summary:
A reliability day: steadier Flux generation, an auto-deployed model health monitor, and refreshed integration plumbing.

The io.net Flux path now includes its required x-enter-token header, while Flux generation consistently runs at the maximum four-step setting. Fewer configuration-shaped surprises between a prompt and its pixels.

A model health-status view landed in the Pollinations app, and the model monitor was added to apps.json for automatic deployment. The infrastructure now has a more direct way to report whether it is having a normal day.

The G4F integration received an update, and bot authentication moved from the POLLI_PAT token to the POLLY_BOT app token.
